map.酒店服务质量评分 = 前台服务 + 客房清洁度 + 设施完好度 + 餐饮服务 +: Hotel service quality score = front desk service + room cleanliness + facility condition + food and beverage service + safety management + customer satisfaction (each scored 1 to 5), average = total ÷ 6; an average of 4.5 or above is excellent, 3.5 to 4.4 is good, 2.5 to 3.4 is average and below 2.5 is poor - build the improvement plan around the lowest-scoring dimension.

map.门店月度/季度服务质量巡检：6 维度（前台/客房清洁/设施/餐饮/安全/满意度）: Monthly or quarterly store inspection: score the six dimensions (front desk / room cleanliness / facilities / F&B / safety / satisfaction) to output a total and the weakest item as an operations improvement list.
map.神秘客或值班经理巡店时，用统一 1-5 分量表现场打分，减少主观松紧不一，便于跨: During mystery guest or duty manager walkthroughs, score on site with the same 1-5 scale to reduce subjective inconsistency and enable cross-store ranking.
map.开业筹备期对标：把新店试运营评分与目标标杆店对比，找出差距维度优先整改。: Pre-opening benchmarking: compare a new store trial-run score with the target benchmark store and prioritize the dimensions that lag.
map.6 维打分：前台 5、客房清洁 4、设施 4、餐饮 3（出餐慢）、安全 5、客户: Six dimension scores: front desk 5, room cleanliness 4, facilities 4, F&B 3 (slow serving), safety 5, customer satisfaction 4 → total = 25, percentage = 25/30×100 ≈ 83 points. The weakest item is F&B (3 points), so fix it first (streamline serving flow / add a breakfast counter); if F&B rises to 4 points the total becomes 26 → 87 points.
map.6 个维度能改权重吗？: Can the six dimensions be reweighted?
map.默认等权（总分 6-30、百分制=总分/30×100）。餐饮/安全对口碑影响大，: Equal weights by default (total 6-30, percentage = total/30×100). F&B and safety strongly affect word of mouth and you may weight them subjectively, but keeping equal weights is recommended for cross-store inspection comparison.
map.评分多久做一次？: How often should scoring be done?
map.建议月度例行 + 重大投诉后即时复评；连续两期低于 70 分（百分制）应启动专项: Monthly routine plus immediate re-evaluation after a major complaint; two consecutive periods below 70 points (on the percentage scale) should trigger a dedicated rectification and a report to the regional manager.
